verdict.rationale: Lovable's own docs describe a custom domain feature that replaces the default xxx.lovable.app URL with your own domain or subdomain. The same page covers buying, connecting, verifying, troubleshooting and managing domains, which builds on publishing the project to a live URL. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the custom-domain connection flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect a custom domain to my published app

citations.quote: A custom domain lets you use your own domain or subdomain for your Lovable project instead of the default xxx.lovable.app URL.
Learn how to buy, connect, verify, troubleshoot, and manage custom domains in Lovable.
Publishing turns your Lovable project into a live web app by deploying a snapshot to a URL you can share.
